bibl.title: "Great Men", Churchmen, and the Others. Forms of Authority in the Villages of the Umayyad Period.
bibl.seg: Arietta Papaconstantinou, "Great Men", Churchmen, and the Others. Forms of Authority in the Villages of the Umayyad Period.
Micaela Langellotti & Dominic Rathbone (edd.), Village Institutions in Egypt in the Roman to Early Arab Periods = Proceedings of the British Academy. 231 (Oxford, 2020) pp. 178-189.
bibl.note: The slow decline of the local secular elites as the Arabs gradually settled in the countryside and took over local echelons of the administration broke the local networks of power and made it possible for the church and its institutions to step into the gap.
